name: task_scheduler
description: A dependency-aware task scheduler that orders tasks with a priority queue, detects cycles, cancels dependent chains and simulates multi-worker makespan.
bugs: _entry() omits the insertion sequence number, so equal-priority tasks run alphabetically instead of in insertion order
_dependents() builds the map with dict.fromkeys(..., []), so every task shares one dependents list
cancel() records children but never pushes them on the stack, so only direct dependents are removed
